text.en: Most customers praise both the retail floor staff and in-store veterinary team for their friendly, approachable attitude. Reviewers highlight assistants who carried heavy parcels to cars or offered tailored advice for rescue pets. Two shoppers noted occasional delays or unhelpful encounters when purchasing aquarium fish, but overall service feedback is positive.

Visitors describe a tidy, well-stocked shop with straightforward aisles and convenient parking in the retail park. Customers particularly commend the efficient click and collect service when collecting bulky pet food orders. One reviewer criticized the size of display enclosures, though most shoppers found the environment bright and accessible.

Pet owners appreciate the welcoming atmosphere for visiting animals, noting that staff frequently greet dogs with kind words and treats. Reviewers also praise the care provided by the on-site veterinary and grooming teams. While one reviewer raised concerns regarding hamster housing, most clients describe clean and well-treated animals.

q.en: Is click and collect available for bulky items?

a.en: Yes, customers report that orders were brought out promptly, with staff even helping load heavy items into cars.

q.en: Does the Kirkstall location have parking facilities?

a.en: Yes, visitors note that there is generous and straightforward parking directly adjacent to the retail store.

q.en: Are veterinary and grooming services located in-store?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight on-site veterinary practice and grooming facilities alongside the main retail area.
